hero.eyebrow: Japanese, in the things that are real
hero.heading: Learn Japanese from the Japanese you actually want to understand.
hero.subtitle: Bring a real video. Korume helps you listen a little closer, say it out loud, notice the little things in each sentence, and meet them again when the time is right.
hero.note: Nothing complicated to set up. Just start with something you already want to watch.

video.title: Travel to Japan: Kyoto in Autumn
video.stillAlt: A quiet Kyoto street at dusk, with lanterns just beginning to glow.

transcript.lineOne: この通りは、いつ来ても落ち着きます。
transcript.lineTwo: 紅葉の季節には更に美しいです。

sentence.label: Sentence
sentence.jp: この通りは、いつ来ても静かで落ち着きます。
sentence.romaji: Kono tōri wa, itsu kite mo shizuka de ochitsukimasu.
sentence.en: This street always feels quiet and peaceful whenever I come here.

companion.name: Companion
companion.body: I think this one is worth remembering.

problem.eyebrow: Japanese doesn't live on the page
problem.heading: You can study Japanese for years and still feel a little lost when real Japanese starts moving.
problem.body: A word has more than a definition. A sentence has more than grammar. In real Japanese, everything happens together — and Korume helps you notice what's there.

example.jp: この店、思ったより安いね。
example.en: This place is cheaper than I thought.

problem.photoAlt: A learner at a desk at night, wearing headphones and quietly focused on a lesson.

journey.heading: Don't learn Japanese in pieces.
journey.body: Watch something you actually care about. Pause at a sentence you like. Listen again. Try saying it. Keep one little thing worth remembering. From one video, Korume helps you take the next small step.

understand.name: Understand
understand.detail: この店は、思ったより安い。
understand.gloss: This place is cheaper than I thought.

journey.thumbnailAlt: A still from a Japanese lesson featuring a quiet street scene.

pitch.heading: Turn something you hear into something your mouth can do.
pitch.body: See the pitch. Feel the rhythm. Try again. Little by little, Japanese starts to find its way into your own voice.

example.jp: 日本の秋はとても美しいですね。

companion.name: Companion
companion.body: Hmm... that sounded a little closer to natural Japanese.

pitch.chartLabel: Two pitch contours compared: a native speaker's and yours.

cta.body: Bring something real. A video, a sentence, a little curiosity. Korume will start from there with you.
